template.colour: RGB hex from tokens.json (official tokens); print values (CMYK) are in tokens.json

reference_note: Faithful vector reproduction of the source page (source colours as a viewer shows them, original copy including typos). Hidden leftovers are listed under omitted.
notes: 700 x 1000 mm, no bleed in the source (page = trim, RGB ICC). Navy field: one source path of 847 x 1127 mm (-117 / -177 to 730 / 949.5) of which only the part on the page is visible: the top and the sides run off the page, the lower left is cut by an arc, white paper below it up to x 349, a vertical edge and a pointed bottom right. The template rebuilds the visible part as a path (source path intersected with the page plus 3 mm bleed with pathops, as in the tariff panel). The reference also keeps a navy rectangle (70.8 to 644.1 x 112.5 to 383.2 mm, #233A89 against the field #23398E) that is faintly visible in the source as a slightly different blue; it is a leftover and is not in the template. P+R symbol: py-comp-symbol-pr scaled 5.964x at 100.0 / 59.8 mm, live label P+R Ubuntu Bold 270.4 mm white. Location: white outline pill 311.2 x 87.0 mm (stroke 6 pt = 2.12 mm, full round) with the garage symbol of py-comp-lockup-location-garage (white, scale 0.66, strip_text) and own live text, Ubuntu Bold 27.8 mm white (Parking / Mandelapark, baselines 512.2 and 537.2): the proportions of the library lockup do not hold here either (see the sticker). Price bubble: py-comp-price-bubble-speech at scale 1.1893 and rotation -0.67 degrees (matches the source path), cut to the bleed at the left page edge (it sticks out 21 mm in the source); live Ubuntu Bold white, rotated -6.9 degrees: '€6' 181.2 mm, ',-' 67.6 mm, 'per dag' 50.5 mm (outlined in the source, fitted by overlay; the suffix is scaled from the sticker, 1.75x). URL tag: new comp py-comp-url-tag-chevron at 458.5 / 938.4 mm (on white paper). Colours: file blue #23398E and tag #374F9C are the token navy, light aqua #78C9DC (no token) as sampled. Variables: label-pr, price, price-suffix, label, location-line-1, location-line-2, url-bold, url-regular, background-colour. Same location name and price as the sticker; the web address voordeligparkeren.nl is not the www.parkingyou.nl used elsewhere (open point for the owner). No spelling errors found. No cut contour: a poster.
